verdict.rationale: Refunds are a fair question for a point-of-sale product, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions issuing full or partial refunds to the original card from POS, admin, or API. The only related item covers exchanges, which is an adjacent feature, and generic GraphQL Admin API access from extensions is a developer building block, not a documented refund capability.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds back to the original card from the point of sale, dashboard, or API
